Raw Coxeter and arithmetic conditions do not yet force such a witness, and this certificate class does not exhaust all possible surface carriers. corrected_extension_class.membership_semantics: A normalized raw oriented wall datum P belongs when there exists a finite certificate, derived from P's exact contraction/dependency data, passing every gate below.  Coordinates are witnesses, not a stored surface/type template.
corrected_extension_class.name: C_FG_HilbExt

tower_gate.ambient: A finite tower T_i of geometrically integral parameter schemes carrying smooth projective geometrically integral rational surfaces X_i/T_i.
tower_gate.centre_step: The new centre is the universal section over a nonempty open in X_i, with Jacobian/saturation certificates for smoothness, prescribed incidences, distinctness and avoidance.  Blowing up the relative smooth section gives X_(i+1).
tower_gate.constant_rank: A finite complex representing R*pi_*(L) is supplied.  Fitting/minor identities certify a locally free rank-r H0 bundle, base change, and the claimed incidence/jet kernel on the same irreducible component.
tower_gate.explicit_curve_step: A rank-one or exceptional system may instead supply a coefficient vector with exact incidence, Jacobian, saturation, absolute-irreducibility and strict-transform smoothness certificates.  Type VII uses this branch.
tower_gate.irreducible_parameter_induction: Each next T is a nonempty open in a constant-rank projective bundle over the previous geometrically integral T.  Hence finite intersections of the certified dense opens are nonempty and geometrically integral.

moving_curve_step.finite_Hilbert_certificate: On Hilb^1(X_i/T_i) and Hilb^2(X_i/T_i), maximal-minor/Fitting ideals of the universal evaluation cokernel have empty support, certified by saturation/elimination (unit ideal on each chart).
moving_curve_step.good_open: Smoothness and geometric integrality follow on a nonempty generic-fibre open by smooth Bertini and Jouanolou irreducibility.  Every additional incidence, transversality and avoidance bad locus has a saturated ideal and a Hilbert-dimension certificate proving it proper.
moving_curve_step.required: After resolving the assigned base cluster, evaluation separates every relative length-one and length-two subscheme; equivalently the induced map X_i -> P_T(V^*) is a relative closed immersion.

proof_kernel: The core calibration supplies a geometrically integral initial parameter point.
A relative smooth-section blowup preserves smooth geometrically integral fibres.
Fitting/base-change certificates make each section space a constant-rank vector bundle.
Length-one/two separation makes the resolved system a relative closed immersion.
Smooth Bertini plus Jouanolou gives a dense open of smooth geometrically integral divisors.
Proper-bad-locus Hilbert certificates and irreducibility keep the simultaneous good open nonempty.
Induction through the projective-bundle tower yields a geometric point of the whole dependency branch.
The final two exact Hilbert ranks give |-K| empty and |-2K| the displayed reduced boundary.
corrected_sufficient_theorem.statement: Every finite branch accepted by C_FG_HilbExt is geometrically nonempty: over the algebraic closure it produces a marked strong Coble root seed.  For branches also passing D_CobVin, the full nef chamber is exactly P, and Kondo's classification imposes the recorded dimension/type restrictions.

hostile_audit.jet_warning: Surjectivity on first jets at each single point alone does not separate distinct points; the certificate requires all relative length-two subschemes.
hostile_audit.rejected_old_clause: Base-point-free plus generically separable is insufficient: |O(2,0)| on P1xP1 is composed with the first projection and a general member is two fibres.
hostile_audit.template_warning: No surface label or classified output is allowed in membership.  Kondo is invoked only after geometric nonemptiness and exact same-P return.
hostile_audit.why_corrected_gate_rejects_it: The map is not a closed immersion and fails to separate two points on the same first-projection fibre.

rating.positive_gain: The false AG implication is replaced by a rigorous certificate theorem, a fifth exact explicit core is integrated, and Kondo gives class-wide extension-length bounds.
